**Finding: Deviation (medium) — § 7.2, ¶ p0027**

Section 7.2 contains an MFN pointed the wrong way: *"Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms Customer offers any other technology supplier."* This is an open-ended obligation on us with no product scope, no term limit, and no reasonable-comparison carve-outs — the playbook walk-away position. It also directly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** delete ¶ p0027 in its entirety. No cross-references depend on it (the second § 7.2 on invoicing is a separate paragraph), and no Vendor-granted MFN is disturbed. Fallback offered in the comment: an MFN limited to a single named product for 12 months with reasonable-comparison carve-outs.
